Aotearoa/Saigon Dinner
Oct 2025 • Friends
We had the best experience having some wines during happy hour before dinner. Buy one, get one free, and the house red was delicious. We decided to eat dinner there and had the best meal and service! Hanh was our server throughout and she was friendly and fun, and went out of her way to help us. Nga was great as well and Tan even put on gloves and removed the shlles from my tiger prawns, saving my white t-shirt from some carnage. Would definitely recommend if in Ho Chi Minh City!
